scenarios.scenario_abstract: At a dry R&B stadium concert with a strict clear-bag rule, [X] alternates between filming and dancing, then stows the phone while moving through tight concourses, bathroom lines, and steep seating; the visible opening must stay secure without making every retrieval a struggle.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一场天气干燥、执行严格透明包规定的 R&B 体育场演唱会上，[X]会在拍摄与跳舞之间反复切换，并在狭窄通道、洗手间队伍和陡峭看台间移动时收起手机；透明可见的包口既要保持牢靠，又不能让每次取用都过于费力。
examples: using Zipper when the visible phone must be fully enclosed after each recording
using Clip as a secondary tether or tactile confirmation before moving into the crowd
rejecting No Closure when the phone would remain exposed in a dense venue

scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] studies business in Madrid and carries a EUR 1,500 laptop between central-city cafes, packing it whenever leaving the table and looping a low-profile urban backpack around a chair; the opening should remain unobtrusive to strangers yet practical through repeated setup and pack-away cycles.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]在马德里读商科，需要在市中心的咖啡馆之间携带价值 1500 欧元的笔记本电脑；每次离桌都会把电脑收好，并把低调的城市背包绕在椅腿上，因此包口既不能引起陌生人注意或被顺手打开，又要方便反复展开与收纳设备。
examples: using Zipper for an opening concealed against the wearer's back
using Clip on a top flap as an extra obstacle and visible check
using Turn Lock when deliberate confirmation is worth one extra motion before leaving the table

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a long-distance relocation handled mostly by public transport, [X] limits the load to two carry-on-size bags and one personal item, repeatedly reaches for tickets, identification, medicine, and a charger, and needs valuables to remain secured through transfers without slowing every access.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一次主要依靠公共交通完成的长途搬迁中，[X]把行李限制为两个登机尺寸包和一件随身物品，并会反复取用车票、证件、药品和充电器；贵重物品需要在多次换乘中保持安全，但每次取用又不能过慢。
examples: using Zipper for identification, money, and the main load
using Snap or Magnetic for a repeatedly accessed ticket pocket when lower security is acceptable
using Buckle when a fuller outer section must stay closed through transfers

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After recently starting to commute by public transport, [X] uses the same laptop backpack every day, opens the organizer pocket for keys, wallet, and identification, and monitors the main opening and its hardware for wear while expecting a 15-inch laptop and work kit to remain protected through months of crowded travel.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始乘公共交通通勤后，[X]每天使用同一只笔记本电脑背包，会打开整理袋取钥匙、钱包和证件，也会留意主包口及其五金在长期使用中的磨损，同时要求 15 英寸电脑和工作用品在数月的拥挤通勤中持续受到保护。
examples: using Zipper when robust teeth and pulls support repeated daily opening
using Snap or Magnetic only on the small organizer pocket where speed matters more than full enclosure
rejecting No Closure for the compartment holding the laptop and work kit

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a month in Osaka, [X] removes a backpack on crowded trains, shifts it between the feet and overhead storage, retrieves a phone and transit card throughout the day, and returns from anime shops with purchases that change how full the opening is.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在大阪停留一个月期间，[X]会在拥挤列车上取下背包，将其放在脚边或行李架上，并在一天中多次取用手机和交通卡；从动漫商店出来后，新增购物物品还会改变包口的装满程度。
examples: using Zipper when the backpack is repeatedly set down or stored overhead
using Drawstring when soft purchases change the opening width during the day
using Buckle as a visible retention step before boarding a crowded train

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During scheduled deep-focus blocks, [X] places the phone out of reach inside a closed bag so checking social media requires standing up, opening the bag, and consciously interrupting the routine rather than following an automatic impulse.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在预先安排的深度专注时段里，[X]会故意把手机放到够不着的位置并收进闭合的包中，让查看社交媒体必须先起身、开包并有意识地打断当前流程，而不是顺着下意识冲动拿起手机。
examples: using Zipper when the extra opening step is meant to create deliberate friction
rejecting Magnetic or Snap when they make the phone nearly as effortless to reach as before
rejecting No Closure because mere distance is not enough to interrupt the habit

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After a backpack zipper pull breaks, [X] photographs the damage for an RMA request and evaluates whether the closure can still be operated reliably, repaired without weakening the opening, or should be replaced before the bag returns to regular use.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 背包的拉链拉片损坏后，[X]为 RMA 售后申请拍下故障照片，并判断这个闭合结构是否还能可靠操作、能否在不削弱包口的情况下维修，或是否应在背包恢复日常使用前直接更换。
examples: preferring a durable Zipper whose pull can withstand repeated use
using Clip as a temporary operable pull only when it does not compromise closure
rejecting continued use when the opening can no longer be fully checked or secured

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After having a phone snatched while walking, [X] keeps the phone out of sight in a close-fitting waist carrier and treats the way it closes as part of a gradual plan to feel safe enough to leave home again.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在步行时曾被人抢走手机后，[X]会把手机藏在贴身腰包里，并把包口的闭合方式作为逐步恢复外出安全感计划的一部分。
examples: using Zipper to keep the phone enclosed and out of sight while moving
using Clip only when it cannot release through ordinary running motion
rejecting No Closure or an easy Magnetic flap when the prior snatching experience keeps the phone exposed

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a seven-day Bali trip split among beaches, boat transfers, waterfalls, and temples, [X] needs a small dry bag that can be sealed against spray and wet clothing, reopened during the day, and checked before moving on.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一趟为期七天、行程包含海滩、乘船换乘、瀑布和寺庙的巴厘岛旅行中，[X]需要一只小型防水干袋，既能封住水花和湿衣物，又能在白天反复打开，并在继续移动前确认已经重新闭合。
examples: using Buckle or Clip to hold a rolled dry-bag opening shut during boat transfers
using Zipper only when the sealed construction still protects the named contents from spray
rejecting No Closure around wet clothing, electronics, and changing water-side conditions

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before cooking on a revised ninety-minute evening schedule, [X] walks five minutes to a nearby shop for only pasta and a jar of sauce and carries them straight home in a reusable shopping bag. An open-top bag suits this direct errand: the two low-risk groceries can go in and out immediately, with no transfer, crowd, or valuable item requiring an extra fastening step.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 按照调整后的九十分钟晚间安排做饭前，[X]步行五分钟到附近商店，只购买意面和一瓶酱料，再用可重复使用的购物袋直接带回家。这个短途直达任务适合敞口袋：两件低风险杂货可以直接放入取出，途中没有换乘、拥挤人群或贵重物需要额外扣合保护。
examples: using No Closure for the two-item reusable shopping bag on the direct walk home
reconsidering a closure only if the errand later adds loose small goods, valuables, crowds, or a longer transfer
